answer: Operator Liability Escrow. Each agent identity is tied to an off-chain legal or collateral account controlled by its operator, joined to the wallet by a signed thread. If a cluster of identities is flagged as sybil, the enforcement rule voids the cluster and debits the operator's escrow per identity, not the wallets. A single bad vine can cost its grower the whole ferrous deposit backing every identity they run, so each additional fake identity multiplies real exposure.
